constant size_bv : t18

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

predicate infix_lseq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls x y \/ x = y

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

axiom Assoc :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int.
   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

  prop Assoc1 = Assoc,  *)

(* clone algebra.Monoid with type t2 = int, constant unit = zero,
  function op1 = infix_pl, prop Unit_def_r1 = Unit_def_r,

(* clone algebra.Group with type t3 = int, function inv = prefix_mn,

  prop Inv_def_r1 = Inv_def_r, prop Inv_def_l1 = Inv_def_l,

  prop Assoc3 = Assoc,  *)

axiom Comm : forall x:int, y:int. infix_pl x y = infix_pl y x

(* clone algebra.Comm with type t4 = int, function op3 = infix_pl,
  prop Comm1 = Comm,  *)

axiom Assoc5 :

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

axiom Mod_bound [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound, function mod *)

axiom Div_unique :
  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_unique, function div *)

axiom Div_bound :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div x y) /\ infix_lseq (div x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound, function div *)

axiom Mod_1 : forall x:int. mod x 1 = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1, function mod *)

axiom Div_1 : forall x:int. div x 1 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1, function div *)

axiom Div_inf :

   infix_ls 0 x /\ infix_lseq x y -> div (prefix_mn x) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf_neg, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_0, function mod *)

  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

constant size_bv : t18

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]

    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

  forall self:t20.
   infix_lseq 1 (length (to_utf8_char self)) /\
   infix_lseq (length (to_utf8_char self)) 4

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

predicate is_signed_positive t18

function of_int int : t18

function to_int (x:t18) : int =
  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

axiom to_uint_extensionality :
  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. tqtint v = tqtint vqt -> v = vqt

  function tqtint *)

  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. to_int v = to_int vqt -> v = vqt

  function to_int *)

predicate uint_in_range (i:int) = infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i tqtmaxInt

axiom to_uint_bounds :
  forall v:t18. infix_lseq 0 (tqtint v) /\ infix_ls (tqtint v) two_power_size

   infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i two_power_size -> tqtint (of_int i) = i

   infix_lseq (prefix_mn two_power_sizem1) (to_int v) /\

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

       infix_ls (infix_mn (to_int a) (to_int b)) two_power_sizem1)

predicate eq_sub_bv t18 t18 t18 t18

axiom eq_sub_bv_def :
  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   let mask = lsl_bv (sub (lsl_bv one3 n) one3) i in
   eq_sub_bv a b i n <-> bw_and b mask = bw_and a mask

predicate eq_sub (a:t18) (b:t18) (i:int) (n:int) =
  forall j:int.
   infix_lseq i j /\ infix_ls j (infix_pl i n) -> nth a j = nth b j

  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   eq_sub a b (tqtint i) (tqtint n) <-> eq_sub_bv a b i n

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.

   forall i:int.

    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

   infix_lseq 0 n ->
   nth (rotate_left v n) i = nth v (mod (infix_mn i n) size)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Nth_rotate_left,
  function rotate_left *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Power_0, function pow2 *)

  forall n:int. infix_gteq n 0 -> pow2 (infix_pl n 1) = infix_as 2 (pow2 n)

predicate is_signed_positive t18

function of_int int : t18

function to_int (x:t18) : int =
  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

axiom to_uint_extensionality :
  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. tqtint v = tqtint vqt -> v = vqt

  function to_int *)

axiom to_uint_bounds :
  forall v:t18. infix_lseq 0 (tqtint v) /\ infix_ls (tqtint v) two_power_size

   infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i two_power_size -> tqtint (of_int i) = i

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

   let mask = lsl_bv (sub (lsl_bv one3 n) one3) i in

  forall j:int.
   infix_lseq i j /\ infix_ls j (infix_pl i n) -> nth a j = nth b j

   eq_sub a b (tqtint i) (tqtint n) <-> eq_sub_bv a b i n

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

  forall self:t20.

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

function cons (x:'a) (s:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))
  (fun (i:int) -> if i = 0 then x else mixfix_lbrb s (infix_mn i 1))

axiom consqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall x:'a, s:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures] length (cons x s) = infix_pl 1 (length s)

axiom consqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall x:'a, s:seq 'a. [@hyp_name:Ensures] mixfix_lbrb (cons x s) 0 = x

axiom consqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall x:'a, s:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_ls 0 i /\ infix_lseq i (length s) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (cons x s) i = mixfix_lbrb s (infix_mn i 1)

function snoc (s:seq 'a) (x:'a) : seq 'a =
  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))
  (fun (i:int) -> if i = length s then x else mixfix_lbrb s i)

function mixfix_lbdtdtrb (seq 'a) int int : seq 'a

   ([@hyp_name:Requires]

   mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j =
   create (infix_mn j i) (fun (k:int) -> mixfix_lbrb s (infix_pl i k))

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   ([@hyp_name:Ensures] length (mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j) = infix_mn j i)

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   ([@hyp_name:Ensures]
    forall k:int.
     infix_lseq 0 k /\ infix_ls k (infix_mn j i) ->

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop infix_plplqtspecqt1,
  function infix_plpl *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop infix_plplqtspecqt0,
  function infix_plpl *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop infix_plplqtspec,
  function infix_plpl *)

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

function abs (x:int) : int = if infix_gteq x 0 then x else prefix_mn x

axiom Abs_le :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_lseq (abs x) y <-> infix_lseq (prefix_mn y) x /\ infix_lseq x y

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_le, function abs *)

axiom Abs_pos : forall x:int. infix_gteq (abs x) 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_pos, function abs *)

function div int int : int

function mod int int : int

axiom Div_mod [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function mod *)

axiom Mod_bound [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound, function mod *)

axiom Div_unique :
  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_unique, function div *)

axiom Div_bound :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div x y) /\ infix_lseq (div x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound, function div *)

axiom Mod_1 : forall x:int. mod x 1 = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1, function mod *)

axiom Div_1 : forall x:int. div x 1 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1, function div *)

axiom Div_inf :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_lseq 0 x /\ infix_ls x y -> div x y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf, function div *)

axiom Div_inf_neg :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_ls 0 x /\ infix_lseq x y -> div (prefix_mn x) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf_neg, function div *)

axiom Mod_0 : forall y:int. not y = 0 -> mod 0 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_0, function mod *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1_left, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1_left, function mod *)

  forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod (- 1) y = infix_mn y 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_minus1_left, function mod *)

  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].

  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

predicate eq_sub_bv t18 t18 t18 t18

axiom eq_sub_bv_def :
  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   let mask = lsl_bv (sub (lsl_bv one3 n) one3) i in
   eq_sub_bv a b i n <-> bw_and b mask = bw_and a mask

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop eq_sub_bv_def, predicate eq_sub_bv *)

predicate eq_sub (a:t18) (b:t18) (i:int) (n:int) =
  forall j:int.
   infix_lseq i j /\ infix_ls j (infix_pl i n) -> nth a j = nth b j

axiom eq_sub_equiv :
  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   eq_sub a b (tqtint i) (tqtint n) <-> eq_sub_bv a b i n

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop eq_sub_equiv, predicate eq_sub_bv *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop eq_sub_equiv, predicate eq_sub *)

predicate infix_eqeq1 (v1:t18) (v2:t18) = eq_sub v1 v2 0 size

axiom Extensionality [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall x:t18, y:t18 [infix_eqeq1 x y]. infix_eqeq1 x y -> x = y

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

predicate infix_ls int int

function infix_mn (x:int) (y:int) : int = infix_pl x (prefix_mn y)

predicate infix_lseq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls x y \/ x = y

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

  forall x:int, y:int, z:int.
   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]

    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

function of_int int : t18

function to_int (x:t18) : int =
  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. tqtint v = tqtint vqt -> v = vqt

  function tqtint *)

  function to_int *)

axiom to_uint_bounds :
  forall v:t18. infix_lseq 0 (tqtint v) /\ infix_ls (tqtint v) two_power_size

  forall i:int.
   infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i two_power_size -> tqtint (of_int i) = i

   infix_lseq (prefix_mn two_power_sizem1) (to_int v) /\

   to_int (of_int i) = i

constant size_bv : t18

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

(* meta vc:proved_wf predicate ult, prop ult_wf *)

       (infix_pl (to_int a) (to_int b)) /\

       infix_ls (infix_mn (to_int a) (to_int b)) two_power_sizem1)

  forall value:int.
   infix_lseq 0 value /\ infix_lseq value 255 ->
   tqtint1 (utf8_byte value) = value

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

axiom to_utf8_char_spec [@useraxiom] :
  forall self:t20.
   infix_lseq 1 (length (to_utf8_char self)) /\
   infix_lseq (length (to_utf8_char self)) 4

    else infix_plpl (to_utf8_char (get self 0)) (to_bytes (tail_char self)))

function infix_mn (x:int) (y:int) : int = infix_pl x (prefix_mn y)

predicate infix_gt (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls y x

predicate infix_lseq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls x y \/ x = y

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

axiom Assoc :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int.
   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

  prop Assoc1 = Assoc,  *)

axiom Unit_def_l : forall x:int. infix_pl zero x = x

axiom Unit_def_r : forall x:int. infix_pl x zero = x

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

function div int int : int

function mod int int : int

axiom Div_mod [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function mod *)

axiom Mod_bound [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound, function mod *)

axiom Div_unique :
  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_unique, function div *)

axiom Div_bound :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div x y) /\ infix_lseq (div x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound, function div *)

axiom Mod_1 : forall x:int. mod x 1 = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1, function mod *)

axiom Div_1 : forall x:int. div x 1 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1, function div *)

axiom Div_inf :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_lseq 0 x /\ infix_ls x y -> div x y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf, function div *)

axiom Div_inf_neg :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_ls 0 x /\ infix_lseq x y -> div (prefix_mn x) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf_neg, function div *)

axiom Mod_0 : forall y:int. not y = 0 -> mod 0 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_0, function mod *)

axiom Div_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> div 1 y = 0

axiom Mod_minus1_left :
  forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod (- 1) y = infix_mn y 1

  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].
   infix_gt x 0 -> div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x = infix_pl y (div z x)

axiom Div_mod1 [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div1 x y)) (mod1 x y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod1, function div1 *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod1, function mod1 *)

axiom Div_bound1 [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div1 x y) /\ infix_lseq (div1 x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound1, function div1 *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound1, function mod1 *)

axiom Mod_bound1 [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 ->
   infix_ls (prefix_mn (abs y)) (mod1 x y) /\ infix_ls (mod1 x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound1, function div1 *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound1, function mod1 *)

  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 -> infix_gteq (div1 x y) 0

axiom Div_sign_neg [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_lseq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 -> infix_lseq (div1 x y) 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_sign_neg, function div1 *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_sign_neg, function mod1 *)

axiom Mod_sign_pos [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_gteq x 0 /\ not y = 0 -> infix_gteq (mod1 x y) 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_sign_pos, function div1 *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_sign_pos, function mod1 *)

axiom Mod_sign_neg [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_lseq x 0 /\ not y = 0 -> infix_lseq (mod1 x y) 0

predicate is_signed_positive t18

function of_int int : t18

function to_int (x:t18) : int =
  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

axiom to_uint_extensionality :
  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. tqtint v = tqtint vqt -> v = vqt

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_uint_extensionality,
  function tqtint *)

axiom to_int_extensionality :
  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. to_int v = to_int vqt -> v = vqt

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_int_extensionality,
  function to_int *)

predicate uint_in_range (i:int) = infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i tqtmaxInt

axiom to_uint_bounds :
  forall v:t18. infix_lseq 0 (tqtint v) /\ infix_ls (tqtint v) two_power_size

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_uint_bounds, function tqtint *)

axiom to_uint_of_int :
  forall i:int.
   infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i two_power_size -> tqtint (of_int i) = i

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_uint_of_int, function tqtint *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_uint_of_int, function of_int *)

axiom to_int_bounds :
  forall v:t18.
   infix_lseq (prefix_mn two_power_sizem1) (to_int v) /\
   infix_ls (to_int v) two_power_sizem1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_int_bounds, function to_int *)

axiom to_int_of_int :
  forall i:int.
   infix_lseq (prefix_mn two_power_sizem1) i /\ infix_ls i two_power_sizem1 ->
   to_int (of_int i) = i

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_int_of_int, function of_int *)

constant size_bv : t18

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

predicate ult (x:t18) (y:t18) = infix_ls (tqtint x) (tqtint y)

axiom ult_wf : well_founded (fun (y0:t18) (y1:t18) -> ult y0 y1)

(* meta vc:proved_wf predicate ult, prop ult_wf *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop ult_wf, predicate ult *)

  not infix_ls (infix_pl (tqtint a) (tqtint b)) two_power_size

  not (infix_lseq (prefix_mn two_power_sizem1)
       (infix_pl (to_int a) (to_int b)) /\
       infix_ls (infix_pl (to_int a) (to_int b)) two_power_sizem1)

  not (infix_lseq (prefix_mn two_power_sizem1)
       (infix_mn (to_int a) (to_int b)) /\
       infix_ls (infix_mn (to_int a) (to_int b)) two_power_sizem1)

  not infix_ls (infix_as (tqtint a) (tqtint b)) two_power_size

       (infix_as (to_int a) (to_int b)) /\

(* use why3.Unit.Unit *)

type t 'a =
  | Tqtmk [@builtin] (current:'a) (final:'a) (id:int)

(* meta model_record function id *)

(* meta model_record function final *)

(* meta model_record function current *)

function borrow_logic (cur:'a) (fin:'a) (id1:int) : t 'a = Tqtmk cur fin id1

function get_id (x:t 'a) : int = x.id

function inherit_id int int : int

(* use creusot.prelude.MutBorrow *)

constant zero : int = 0

constant one : int = 1

function prefix_mn int : int

function infix_pl int int : int

function infix_as int int : int

predicate infix_ls int int

function infix_mn (x:int) (y:int) : int = infix_pl x (prefix_mn y)

predicate infix_gt (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls y x

predicate infix_lseq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls x y \/ x = y

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

axiom Assoc :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int.
   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

(* clone algebra.Assoc with type t1 = int, function op = infix_pl,
  prop Assoc1 = Assoc,  *)

axiom Unit_def_l : forall x:int. infix_pl zero x = x

axiom Unit_def_r : forall x:int. infix_pl x zero = x

(* clone algebra.Monoid with type t2 = int, constant unit = zero,
  function op1 = infix_pl, prop Unit_def_r1 = Unit_def_r,
  prop Unit_def_l1 = Unit_def_l, prop Assoc2 = Assoc,  *)

axiom Inv_def_l : forall x:int. infix_pl (prefix_mn x) x = zero

axiom Inv_def_r : forall x:int. infix_pl x (prefix_mn x) = zero

(* clone algebra.Group with type t3 = int, function inv = prefix_mn,
  constant unit1 = zero, function op2 = infix_pl,
  prop Inv_def_r1 = Inv_def_r, prop Inv_def_l1 = Inv_def_l,
  prop Unit_def_r2 = Unit_def_r, prop Unit_def_l2 = Unit_def_l,
  prop Assoc3 = Assoc,  *)

axiom Comm : forall x:int, y:int. infix_pl x y = infix_pl y x

(* clone algebra.Comm with type t4 = int, function op3 = infix_pl,
  prop Comm1 = Comm,  *)

(* meta AC function infix_pl *)

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

function abs (x:int) : int = if infix_gteq x 0 then x else prefix_mn x

axiom Abs_le :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_lseq (abs x) y <-> infix_lseq (prefix_mn y) x /\ infix_lseq x y

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_le, function abs *)

axiom Abs_pos : forall x:int. infix_gteq (abs x) 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_pos, function abs *)

function div int int : int

function mod int int : int

axiom Div_mod [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function mod *)

axiom Mod_bound [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound, function mod *)

axiom Div_unique :
  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_unique, function div *)

axiom Div_bound :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div x y) /\ infix_lseq (div x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound, function div *)

axiom Mod_1 : forall x:int. mod x 1 = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1, function mod *)

axiom Div_1 : forall x:int. div x 1 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1, function div *)

axiom Div_inf :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_lseq 0 x /\ infix_ls x y -> div x y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf, function div *)

axiom Div_inf_neg :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_ls 0 x /\ infix_lseq x y -> div (prefix_mn x) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf_neg, function div *)

axiom Mod_0 : forall y:int. not y = 0 -> mod 0 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_0, function mod *)

axiom Div_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> div 1 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1_left, function div *)

axiom Div_minus1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> div (- 1) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_minus1_left, function div *)

axiom Mod_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod 1 y = 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1_left, function mod *)

axiom Mod_minus1_left :
  forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod (- 1) y = infix_mn y 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_minus1_left, function mod *)

axiom Div_mult :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].
   infix_gt x 0 -> div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x = infix_pl y (div z x)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mult, function div *)

axiom Mod_mult :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [mod (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].
   infix_gt x 0 -> mod (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x = mod z x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_mult, function mod *)

  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

constant size_bv : t18

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

function cons (x:'a) (s:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))
  (fun (i:int) -> if i = 0 then x else mixfix_lbrb s (infix_mn i 1))

axiom consqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall x:'a, s:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures] length (cons x s) = infix_pl 1 (length s)

axiom consqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall x:'a, s:seq 'a. [@hyp_name:Ensures] mixfix_lbrb (cons x s) 0 = x

axiom consqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall x:'a, s:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_ls 0 i /\ infix_lseq i (length s) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (cons x s) i = mixfix_lbrb s (infix_mn i 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop consqtspecqt1, function cons *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop consqtspecqt0, function cons *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop consqtspec, function cons *)

function snoc (s:seq 'a) (x:'a) : seq 'a =
  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))
  (fun (i:int) -> if i = length s then x else mixfix_lbrb s i)

axiom snocqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, x:'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures] length (snoc s x) = infix_pl 1 (length s)

axiom snocqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, x:'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures] mixfix_lbrb (snoc s x) (length s) = x

axiom snocqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, x:'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (snoc s x) i = mixfix_lbrb s i

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop snocqtspecqt1, function snoc *)

function mixfix_lbdtdtrb (seq 'a) int int : seq 'a

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtdef [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j =
   create (infix_mn j i) (fun (k:int) -> mixfix_lbrb s (infix_pl i k))

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   ([@hyp_name:Ensures] length (mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j) = infix_mn j i)

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   ([@hyp_name:Ensures]
    forall k:int.
     infix_lseq 0 k /\ infix_ls k (infix_mn j i) ->
     mixfix_lbrb (mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j) k = mixfix_lbrb s (infix_pl i k))

  function mixfix_lbdtdtrb *)

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

  function infix_plpl *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop infix_plplqtspecqt0,
  function infix_plpl *)

  function infix_plpl *)

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

function abs (x:int) : int = if infix_gteq x 0 then x else prefix_mn x

axiom Abs_le :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_lseq (abs x) y <-> infix_lseq (prefix_mn y) x /\ infix_lseq x y

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_le, function abs *)

axiom Abs_pos : forall x:int. infix_gteq (abs x) 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_pos, function abs *)

function div int int : int

function mod int int : int

axiom Div_mod [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function mod *)

axiom Mod_bound [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound, function mod *)

axiom Div_unique :
  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_unique, function div *)

axiom Div_bound :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div x y) /\ infix_lseq (div x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound, function div *)

axiom Mod_1 : forall x:int. mod x 1 = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1, function mod *)

axiom Div_1 : forall x:int. div x 1 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1, function div *)

axiom Div_inf :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_lseq 0 x /\ infix_ls x y -> div x y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf, function div *)

axiom Div_inf_neg :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_ls 0 x /\ infix_lseq x y -> div (prefix_mn x) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf_neg, function div *)

axiom Mod_0 : forall y:int. not y = 0 -> mod 0 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_0, function mod *)

axiom Mod_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod 1 y = 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1_left, function mod *)

axiom Mod_minus1_left :
  forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod (- 1) y = infix_mn y 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_minus1_left, function mod *)

axiom Div_mult :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].
   infix_gt x 0 -> div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x = infix_pl y (div z x)

function of_int int : t18

function to_int (x:t18) : int =
  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

axiom to_uint_extensionality :
  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. tqtint v = tqtint vqt -> v = vqt

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

predicate eq_sub_bv t18 t18 t18 t18

axiom eq_sub_bv_def :
  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   let mask = lsl_bv (sub (lsl_bv one3 n) one3) i in
   eq_sub_bv a b i n <-> bw_and b mask = bw_and a mask

predicate eq_sub (a:t18) (b:t18) (i:int) (n:int) =
  forall j:int.
   infix_lseq i j /\ infix_ls j (infix_pl i n) -> nth a j = nth b j

  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   eq_sub a b (tqtint i) (tqtint n) <-> eq_sub_bv a b i n

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

  forall self:t20.
   infix_lseq 1 (length (to_utf8_char self)) /\
   infix_lseq (length (to_utf8_char self)) 4

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.

    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.

    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   infix_ls (infix_pl n s) size -> nth (asr b s) n = nth b (infix_pl n s)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Asr_nth_low, function asr *)

axiom Asr_nth_high :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   infix_gteq (infix_pl n s) size ->
   nth (asr b s) n = nth b (infix_mn size 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Asr_nth_high, function asr *)

axiom asr_zeros : forall x:t18. asr x 0 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop asr_zeros, function asr *)

function lsl t18 int : t18

axiom Lsl_nth_high :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s /\ infix_lseq s n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   nth (lsl b s) n = nth b (infix_mn n s)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Lsl_nth_high, function lsl *)

axiom Lsl_nth_low :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n s -> nth (lsl b s) n = False

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Lsl_nth_low, function lsl *)

axiom lsl_zeros : forall x:t18. lsl x 0 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop lsl_zeros, function lsl *)

function abs (x:int) : int = if infix_gteq x 0 then x else prefix_mn x

axiom Abs_le :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_lseq (abs x) y <-> infix_lseq (prefix_mn y) x /\ infix_lseq x y

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_le, function abs *)

axiom Abs_pos : forall x:int. infix_gteq (abs x) 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_pos, function abs *)

function div int int : int

function mod int int : int

axiom Div_mod [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function mod *)

axiom Mod_bound [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound, function mod *)

axiom Div_unique :
  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_unique, function div *)

axiom Div_bound :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div x y) /\ infix_lseq (div x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound, function div *)

axiom Mod_1 : forall x:int. mod x 1 = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1, function mod *)

axiom Div_1 : forall x:int. div x 1 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1, function div *)

axiom Div_inf :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_lseq 0 x /\ infix_ls x y -> div x y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf, function div *)

axiom Div_inf_neg :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_ls 0 x /\ infix_lseq x y -> div (prefix_mn x) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf_neg, function div *)

axiom Mod_0 : forall y:int. not y = 0 -> mod 0 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_0, function mod *)

axiom Div_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> div 1 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1_left, function div *)

axiom Div_minus1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> div (- 1) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_minus1_left, function div *)

axiom Mod_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod 1 y = 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1_left, function mod *)

axiom Mod_minus1_left :
  forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod (- 1) y = infix_mn y 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_minus1_left, function mod *)

axiom Div_mult :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].
   infix_gt x 0 -> div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x = infix_pl y (div z x)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mult, function div *)

axiom Mod_mult :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [mod (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].
   infix_gt x 0 -> mod (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x = mod z x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_mult, function mod *)

  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

constant size_bv : t18

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

predicate is_signed_positive t18

function of_int int : t18

function to_int (x:t18) : int =
  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

axiom to_uint_extensionality :
  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. tqtint v = tqtint vqt -> v = vqt

  function tqtint *)

  forall v:t18, vqt:t18. to_int v = to_int vqt -> v = vqt

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_int_extensionality,
  function to_int *)

predicate uint_in_range (i:int) = infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i tqtmaxInt

axiom to_uint_bounds :
  forall v:t18. infix_lseq 0 (tqtint v) /\ infix_ls (tqtint v) two_power_size

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop to_uint_bounds, function tqtint *)

  forall i:int.
   infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i two_power_size -> tqtint (of_int i) = i

   infix_lseq (prefix_mn two_power_sizem1) (to_int v) /\

   to_int (of_int i) = i

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

       infix_ls (infix_mn (to_int a) (to_int b)) two_power_sizem1)

predicate eq_sub_bv t18 t18 t18 t18

axiom eq_sub_bv_def :
  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   let mask = lsl_bv (sub (lsl_bv one3 n) one3) i in
   eq_sub_bv a b i n <-> bw_and b mask = bw_and a mask

predicate eq_sub (a:t18) (b:t18) (i:int) (n:int) =
  forall j:int.
   infix_lseq i j /\ infix_ls j (infix_pl i n) -> nth a j = nth b j

  forall a:t18, b:t18, i:t18, n:t18.
   eq_sub a b (tqtint i) (tqtint n) <-> eq_sub_bv a b i n

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

function infix_mn (x:int) (y:int) : int = infix_pl x (prefix_mn y)

predicate infix_lseq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls x y \/ x = y

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

function cons (x:'a) (s:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))
  (fun (i:int) -> if i = 0 then x else mixfix_lbrb s (infix_mn i 1))

  forall x:'a, s:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures] length (cons x s) = infix_pl 1 (length s)

    infix_ls 0 i /\ infix_lseq i (length s) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (cons x s) i = mixfix_lbrb s (infix_mn i 1)

  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))

    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

function nth t18 int : bool

axiom nth_out_of_bound :
  forall x:t18, n:int. infix_ls n 0 \/ infix_gteq n size -> nth x n = False

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop nth_out_of_bound, function nth *)

axiom Nth_zeros : forall n:int. nth zeros n = False

axiom Nth_ones :
  forall n:int. infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size -> nth ones n = True

function bw_and t18 t18 : t18

axiom Nth_bw_and :
  forall v1:t18, v2:t18, n:int.
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   nth (bw_and v1 v2) n = andb (nth v1 n) (nth v2 n)

   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   nth (bw_or v1 v2) n = orb (nth v1 n) (nth v2 n)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Nth_bw_or, function bw_or *)

function bw_xor t18 t18 : t18

axiom Nth_bw_xor :
  forall v1:t18, v2:t18, n:int.
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   nth (bw_xor v1 v2) n = xorb (nth v1 n) (nth v2 n)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Nth_bw_xor, function bw_xor *)

function bw_not t18 : t18

axiom Nth_bw_not :
  forall v:t18, n:int.
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size -> nth (bw_not v) n = notb (nth v n)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Nth_bw_not, function bw_not *)

function lsr t18 int : t18

axiom Lsr_nth_low :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n ->
   infix_ls (infix_pl n s) size -> nth (lsr b s) n = nth b (infix_pl n s)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Lsr_nth_low, function lsr *)

axiom Lsr_nth_high :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n ->
   infix_gteq (infix_pl n s) size -> nth (lsr b s) n = False

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Lsr_nth_high, function lsr *)

axiom lsr_zeros : forall x:t18. lsr x 0 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop lsr_zeros, function lsr *)

function asr t18 int : t18

axiom Asr_nth_low :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   infix_ls (infix_pl n s) size -> nth (asr b s) n = nth b (infix_pl n s)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Asr_nth_low, function asr *)

axiom Asr_nth_high :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   infix_gteq (infix_pl n s) size ->
   nth (asr b s) n = nth b (infix_mn size 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Asr_nth_high, function asr *)

axiom asr_zeros : forall x:t18. asr x 0 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop asr_zeros, function asr *)

function div int int : int

function mod int int : int

axiom Div_mod [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mod, function mod *)

axiom Mod_bound [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_bound, function mod *)

axiom Div_unique :
  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_unique, function div *)

axiom Div_bound :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_gteq x 0 /\ infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq 0 (div x y) /\ infix_lseq (div x y) x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_bound, function div *)

axiom Mod_1 : forall x:int. mod x 1 = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1, function mod *)

axiom Div_1 : forall x:int. div x 1 = x

axiom Div_inf :
  forall x:int, y:int. infix_lseq 0 x /\ infix_ls x y -> div x y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf, function div *)

axiom Div_inf_neg :
  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_ls 0 x /\ infix_lseq x y -> div (prefix_mn x) y = (- 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_inf_neg, function div *)

axiom Mod_0 : forall y:int. not y = 0 -> mod 0 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_0, function mod *)

axiom Div_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> div 1 y = 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_1_left, function div *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_minus1_left, function div *)

axiom Mod_1_left : forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod 1 y = 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_1_left, function mod *)

axiom Mod_minus1_left :
  forall y:int. infix_gt y 1 -> mod (- 1) y = infix_mn y 1

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Mod_minus1_left, function mod *)

axiom Div_mult :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int [div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x].
   infix_gt x 0 -> div (infix_pl (infix_as x y) z) x = infix_pl y (div z x)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Div_mult, function div *)

constant size_bv : t18

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))
  (fun (i:int) -> if i = 0 then x else mixfix_lbrb s (infix_mn i 1))

  create (infix_pl 1 (length s))
  (fun (i:int) -> if i = length s then x else mixfix_lbrb s i)

    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (snoc s x) i = mixfix_lbrb s i

function mixfix_lbdtdtrb (seq 'a) int int : seq 'a

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtdef [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j =
   create (infix_mn j i) (fun (k:int) -> mixfix_lbrb s (infix_pl i k))

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   ([@hyp_name:Ensures] length (mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j) = infix_mn j i)

axiom mixfix_lbdtdtrbqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s:seq 'a, i:int, j:int.
   ([@hyp_name:Requires]
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_lseq i j /\ infix_lseq j (length s)) ->
   ([@hyp_name:Ensures]
    forall k:int.
     infix_lseq 0 k /\ infix_ls k (infix_mn j i) ->
     mixfix_lbrb (mixfix_lbdtdtrb s i j) k = mixfix_lbrb s (infix_pl i k))

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

  function infix_plpl *)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop infix_plplqtspecqt0,
  function infix_plpl *)

  function infix_plpl *)

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

  forall x:int, y:int.
   not y = 0 -> x = infix_pl (infix_as y (div x y)) (mod x y)

   not y = 0 -> infix_lseq 0 (mod x y) /\ infix_ls (mod x y) (abs y)

  forall x:int, y:int, q:int.
   infix_gt y 0 ->
   infix_lseq (infix_as q y) x /\ infix_ls x (infix_pl (infix_as q y) y) ->
   div x y = q

  if is_signed_positive x then tqtint x
  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

type t20

function to_int2 t20 : int

axiom to_int [@useraxiom] :
  forall c:t20.
   (infix_lseq 0 (to_int2 c) /\ infix_ls (to_int2 c) 0x10FFFF) /\
   not (infix_lseq 0xD800 (to_int2 c) /\ infix_ls (to_int2 c) 0xE000)

axiom extensionality [@useraxiom] :
  forall x:t20, y:t20 [to_int2 x, to_int2 y]. to_int2 x = to_int2 y -> x = y

function of_int2 int : t20

axiom to_of_int [@useraxiom] :

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

  else prefix_mn (infix_mn two_power_size (tqtint x))

inductive acc ('a -> 'a -> bool) 'a =
  | acc_x :
      forall r:'a -> 'a -> bool, x:'a.
       (forall y:'a. infix_at (infix_at r y) x = True -> acc r y) -> acc r x

predicate well_founded (r:'a -> 'a -> bool) = forall x:'a. acc r x

(* use why3.WellFounded.WellFounded *)

function to_utf8_char (self:t20) : seq t21 =
  let code = to_int2 self in
  if infix_ls code 128 then singleton (utf8_byte code)
  else if infix_ls code 2048
       then snoc (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 192 (div1 code 64))))
            (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
       else if infix_ls code 65536
            then snoc
                 (snoc
                  (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 224 (div1 code 4096))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))
            else snoc
                 (snoc
                  (snoc
                   (singleton (utf8_byte (infix_pl 240 (div1 code 262144))))
                   (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 4096) 64))))
                  (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 (div1 code 64) 64))))
                 (utf8_byte (infix_pl 128 (mod1 code 64)))

  forall self:t20.
   infix_lseq 1 (length (to_utf8_char self)) /\
   infix_lseq (length (to_utf8_char self)) 4

predicate infix_gt (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls y x

predicate infix_lseq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_ls x y \/ x = y

predicate infix_gteq (x:int) (y:int) = infix_lseq y x

axiom Assoc :
  forall x:int, y:int, z:int.
   infix_pl (infix_pl x y) z = infix_pl x (infix_pl y z)

function infix_plpl (s1:seq 'a) (s2:seq 'a) : seq 'a =
  let l = length s1 in
  create (infix_pl l (length s2))
  (fun (i:int) ->
    if infix_ls i l then mixfix_lbrb s1 i else mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i l))

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt1 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   length (infix_plpl s1 s2) = infix_pl (length s1) (length s2)

axiom infix_plplqtspecqt0 [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq 0 i /\ infix_ls i (length s1) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i = mixfix_lbrb s1 i

axiom infix_plplqtspec [@W:non_conservative_extension:N] :
  forall s1:seq 'a, s2:seq 'a.
   [@hyp_name:Ensures]
   forall i:int.
    infix_lseq (length s1) i /\ infix_ls i (length (infix_plpl s1 s2)) ->
    mixfix_lbrb (infix_plpl s1 s2) i =
    mixfix_lbrb s2 (infix_mn i (length s1))

function andb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | True -> y
  | False -> False
  end

function orb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> True
  end

function notb (x:bool) : bool = match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> False
  end

function xorb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> y
  | True -> notb y
  end

function implb (x:bool) (y:bool) : bool =
  match x with
  | False -> True
  | True -> y
  end

   infix_lseq 0 n ->
   infix_gteq (infix_pl n s) size -> nth (lsr b s) n = False

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Lsr_nth_high, function lsr *)

axiom lsr_zeros : forall x:t18. lsr x 0 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop lsr_zeros, function lsr *)

function asr t18 int : t18

axiom Asr_nth_low :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   infix_ls (infix_pl n s) size -> nth (asr b s) n = nth b (infix_pl n s)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Asr_nth_low, function asr *)

axiom Asr_nth_high :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s ->
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   infix_gteq (infix_pl n s) size ->
   nth (asr b s) n = nth b (infix_mn size 1)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Asr_nth_high, function asr *)

axiom asr_zeros : forall x:t18. asr x 0 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop asr_zeros, function asr *)

function lsl t18 int : t18

axiom Lsl_nth_high :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 s /\ infix_lseq s n /\ infix_ls n size ->
   nth (lsl b s) n = nth b (infix_mn n s)

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Lsl_nth_high, function lsl *)

axiom Lsl_nth_low :
  forall b:t18, n:int, s:int.
   infix_lseq 0 n /\ infix_ls n s -> nth (lsl b s) n = False

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Lsl_nth_low, function lsl *)

axiom lsl_zeros : forall x:t18. lsl x 0 = x

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop lsl_zeros, function lsl *)

function abs (x:int) : int = if infix_gteq x 0 then x else prefix_mn x

  forall x:int, y:int.
   infix_lseq (abs x) y <-> infix_lseq (prefix_mn y) x /\ infix_lseq x y

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_le, function abs *)

axiom Abs_pos : forall x:int. infix_gteq (abs x) 0

(* meta remove_unused:dependency prop Abs_pos, function abs *)
